basic_details.job_title: IICA Consultant- Assistant Librarian Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), Manesar, under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, is filling one Consultant (Assistant Librarian) position in its Knowledge Resource Centre on a purely contractual basis. The monthly consolidated pay is Rs. 40,000/-50,000/-. The essential qualification is a Post Graduate degree along with a Master's in Library Science or an equivalent course, with at least 5 years of library experience. Candidates apply through a Google Form by 18 December 2026; the upper age limit is 63 years.

age_limit.details: The prescribed essential qualifications are only the minimum; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the presentation and/or interview. Provisional claims about eligibility are not accepted. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Consultant- Assistant Librarian Post Graduate along with Masters' in Library Science or equivalent course. Sound knowledge of computer skills, Open Source Softwares, Library Management Software, Mendley, ZoteroDspace, Koha etc. | Essential work experience: at least 5 years experience in organizing and managing library activities in any academic, corporate or research institution.

how_to_apply: Check that you meet the eligibility criteria for age, educational qualification and experience before applying.
Submit your CV through the application Google Form link given in the notice.
Mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum, and make sure all details are complete, accurate and correct.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below with your application.
Apply on or before 18.12.2026. Applications through any other mode will not be considered, and late applications are rejected.
Matriculation or equivalent certificate in support of the declaration of age.
Degree or Diploma Certificate or other certificate including mark-sheets in support of educational qualifications. Mark-sheets alone in place of the Degree/Diploma/Certificate are not accepted.
If the qualification is equivalent, the authority (with number and date) under which it is so treated.

Experience certificate(s) from the Head(s) of Organization(s)/Department(s) for the entire experience claimed, showing the duration of employment (date, month and year), basic pay and consolidated pay as the case may be, and the nature of duties performed. They must be issued on Letter Head and duly stamped by the Competent Authority.

Original certificates should not be sent with the application; they are to be produced at the presentation and/or interview. Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation, Higher Secondary Examination Certificate or an equivalent certificate is accepted, and no later change is considered. If copies of the certificates are not received with the application, it will be rejected and no appeal is entertained.
important_instructions: IICA is not responsible for non-receipt or delay of applications; applications after the last date/time are summarily rejected. Candidature is cancelled if a candidate does not meet the eligibility criteria, gives incorrect or false information, or suppresses a material fact. Documents must not have any correction, alteration or tampering. Any inconsistency between documents needs a written explanation. No TA/DA is permissible to attend the written/skill test and/or interview. Candidates must be of sound health and, if selected, may have to undergo a medical examination if required. The Institute may offer the selected candidate the lower fee/position as it deems appropriate within the same School/Centre. No interim correspondence or personal enquiries are entertained, and IICA does not correspond about reasons for non-selection. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate. Any dispute is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts in Haryana.

content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: IICA, Manesar is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. It works to advance Corporate Affairs as an interdisciplinary discipline and offers courses and training programmes. The notice states that it provides training through five Schools and eleven Centres, and that its campus has a well stocked library and a knowledge management system.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential work experience: at least 5 years experience in organizing and managing library activities in any academic, corporate or research institution. Knowledge and experience in all the day to day technical activities of the Library. Good communication skills, with linguistic aptitude and command over English and Hindi. Strong networking skills; mature attitude with the capability to discuss issues, with good leadership skills. Confident, self-motivated, friendly and a team player. Experience in arranging training-related internal functions and events, and in facilitating lectures, workshops and seminars. Computer literate, with experience in database navigation including SCOPUS/WOS, and well conversant with MS Office. Experience in digital marketing strategies, working mechanisms of social networking sites (Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube etc.), and creating online campaigns on social media platforms, Google ads and other relevant websites to reach targeted participants. Skills in video editing and designing social media posts are an added advantage. The prescribed essential qualifications are only the minimum; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the presentation and/or interview. Provisional claims about eligibility are not accepted. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate along with Masters' in Library Science or equivalent course. Sound knowledge of computer skills, Open Source Softwares, Library Management Software, Mendley, ZoteroDspace, Koha etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/-50,000/-, and the engagement is purely contractual. The notice says no other allowances or benefits such as Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), medical facilities and other compensation packages are admissible. Leave is granted as per the policy of the Institute. The notice does not state the length of the contract. The notice also says the Competent Authority may relax the prescribed eligibility criteria, including the emoluments, for deserving candidates in the interest of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IICA Consultant- Assistant Librarian Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these expected working areas: Acquisition; Periodicals; Technical Processing Database Maintenance; Reference; Circulation Documentation and Publication; Inter Library Services Managing Online Resources; Other Technical updations Orientations to the users; Organising Training Programmes Networking; Liaison Database searching and retrieving relevant literature Handling Social Media; Handling Social Media Marketing

Experience certificate(s) from the Head(s) of Organization(s)/Department(s) for the entire experience claimed, showing the duration of employment (date, month and year), basic pay and consolidated pay as the case may be, and the nature of duties performed. They must be issued on Letter Head and duly stamped by the Competent Authority. Original certificates should not be sent with the application; they are to be produced at the presentation and/or interview. Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation, Higher Secondary Examination Certificate or an equivalent certificate is accepted, and no later change is considered. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications received by the due date are screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience. Only shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview before the duly constituted selection committee. The interview is held at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference, on a date and time communicated separately. The Institute communicates only with shortlisted candidates. The Institute reserves the right to devise its own criteria for shortlisting. Its decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, equivalence of qualifications and the mode of screening and selection is final and binding.
